01

Paths, not lists

Tasks need direction. VoidSteps organizes your work into meaningful paths — not scattered to-do lists that go nowhere.

02

Offline by default

No Wi-Fi? No problem. Your data lives on your device first, syncing seamlessly when you're back online.

03

Focus over features

We don't add features for the sake of it. Every tool exists to help you focus — nothing more, nothing less.

How it works

01

Define your paths

Create paths that represent your goals — career, fitness, learning, or anything you want to pursue. Each path becomes a container for focused progress.

02

Break them into steps

Add actionable steps to each path. Set priorities, due dates, and organize with drag-and-drop. Nest steps for complex goals that need structure.

03

Track & stay focused

Use the focus timer, build routines, and watch your progress grow — even offline. Stay in the zone with a distraction-free interface.
